visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a man wearing a dark blue suit, white shirt, and gold-rimmed glasses adjusting his collar and glasses in a luxurious modern living room with a sea view through large windows. (2) The scene shifts to a behind-the-scenes setting where a stylist in a black mesh top applies makeup and hairspray to the man, who is now wearing a black salon cape. (3) The man looks closely into the camera with a confused expression, then a black-and-blue Braun electric shaver is presented in a hand against a neutral background. (4) In a bathroom setting, the man uses the shaver on his neck and chin, followed by a split-screen comparison showing smooth skin on one side. (5) Back in his suit, the man is superimposed over images of a Rolls-Royce in a showroom and a private jet, then shown standing on the wing of a jet in a blue sky. (6) He enters a cafe, gesturing broadly as if addressing a crowd, but the following shots show the cafe is completely empty. (7) In an office, he scolds an orange tabby cat sitting on a chair, pointing a pointer stick at it, then gestures toward stacks of cash appearing as an overlay. (8) The man stands outside a Costco warehouse, holding the shaver and its packaging, demonstrating its use with exaggerated facial expressions. (9) Close-up shots show the shaver being used on a chin with clear sensor-related text overlays, followed by a demonstration of cleaning the device under running water in a sink. (10) The final phase shows the man back in an office chair, holding the shaver and pointing to the camera with a confident smile.

(2) A mechanical spray sound is heard during the makeup scene, accompanied by a shift to a more casual but still energetic tone. (3) A digital 'whoosh' effect marks the transition to the shaver reveal, followed by the low humming sound of an electric motor. (4) The narrator’s pitch rises as he enthusiastically explains the shaver's features, punctuated by sharp 'ding' sound effects for emphasis. (5) A cartoonish 'cawing' sound or silence follows the cafe entrance joke, creating a comedic beat. (6) In the office phase, the man’s voice becomes mock-authoritative while talking to the cat, ending with a celebratory chime for the bonus mention. (7) Outdoor urban ambience is subtly present during the Costco storefront segment, while the voice remains projected and clear. (8) Splashing water sounds are clearly heard during the cleaning demonstration. (9) The final phase features a strong rhythmic build-up in the BGM with a persuasive, high-arousal closing call-to-action.
